name: Bio pages

requirements.text: Users create published/unpublished bio pages with normalized handles.
Users create, reorder, activate, and delete outbound buttons.
Public pages render only published pages and active items in order.
Page views and button clicks record privacy-minimal events.
Content blocks include image, text, social profiles, and allowlisted media embeds.
Appearance controls include theme, typography, color, background, and responsive preview.
Per-block scheduling, pinning, disable rules, and bio-specific insights are available.
Third-party media blocks use canonical provider IDs, sandboxed renderers, and click-to-load consent before provider requests.
The editor Content, Appearance, and Insights tabs share one public render model and keyboard-accessible block ordering.

externalPrerequisites: Configured durable private media storage through LINKPILOT_MEDIA_DISK

acceptanceCriteria.text: Only published pages and currently eligible active blocks render publicly.
No bio setting permits custom HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
Editor preview and public output use the same validated appearance and block model.

observedBehaviors: A Content tab shows an ordered list of bio blocks.
A live phone-shaped preview occupies the right side of the editor.
An Appearance tab is selected beside Content and Insights.
Background, profile, button, and font controls appear beside a phone preview.
An Insights tab contains summary and chart regions.
The phone preview is replaced by analytics content in this tab.
The bio editor collapses to a narrow single-column content view.
A fixed five-item bottom navigation is visible.

implementationEvidence.description: Bio-link destinations reject application aliases plus pending, active, and failed claimed custom hosts while accepting unrelated HTTP(S) destinations.

The full isolated Laravel suite passed 428 tests and 15,151 assertions; one successful PDF-delivery test was skipped because ClamAV is unavailable. Bio management, content, projection, insight, and media-validation tests passed.
Owner browser at 1440x1000 and 390x844 reviewed Content, Appearance, Insights, click-to-load embeds, and keyboard block ordering; the mobile document width stayed 390px.

At 390x844, a rejected first-party Bio-link destination displayed its server validation alert with aria-invalid=true while preserving submitted values; editing the URL cleared the alert and invalid state.
